pageDescription: Manage your data and storage preferences
dataDirHelp: Replacing the root activates only the selected directory. Nimi does not copy, merge, delete, or keep using the previous root.
dataRootReplaced: The new data root is active. Check & Sync is reconciling owner state.
dataRootUnchanged: This directory is already active. Run Check & Sync to verify it again.
checkSyncModelOfflineConversion: This model's local data needs offline conversion before it can be used. Local models stay limited until then; everything else keeps working.
clearCacheBody: Clear locally cached data. This will not delete your messages or files.
sessionBody: Sign out of your account on this device.
